channel.title: Solvex Audio updates
channel.description: New releases of Solvex Audio, speaker box design software by NordBass.

item.title: Solvex Audio 1.0.0-beta3.1
item.description: Patch: Home and Pro licences no longer activate as Basic, trying again no longer uses up activations, and settings, drivers and projects from older versions carry over.

item.title: Solvex Audio 1.0.0-beta3
item.description: A rebuilt, much lighter app (4 MB on Windows); DXF/SVG cutting sheets for CNC and CAD; a new 3D enclosure view; bandpass (BP4) boxes move down to Home; all 7 languages complete.

item.title: Solvex Audio 1.0.0-beta2
item.description: Bug fixes: the full driver library (100 drivers) now loads on a new install instead of 13; the guided tour and About dialog show the right version; fixed a crash when the 72-hour offline period ran out.

item.title: Solvex Audio 1.0.0-beta1
item.description: The first 1.0 beta. Buying Home and Pro through the online store went live. Fixed port sizes being converted twice in Imperial mode.

item.title: Solvex Audio 0.1.17 open beta
item.description: The first public release: sealed, vented, passive-radiator and bandpass simulation, cutting lists, port tools, fit checks, workshop calculators, a tone generator, 7 languages and an in-app updater.
